title: astragalus floccosus subsp. pichleri
intro: Astragalus floccosus subsp. pichleri, commonly known as Pichler's milkvetch or Pichler's astragalus, is a plant species belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). This perennial herb is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Astragalus floccosus subsp. pichleri include its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to boost the immune system and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-arthritic, and anti-viral properties, with its bioactive constituents including saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
